crossRefs.note: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy…
They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability…
But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing…
But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you…
For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will…
for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”
Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
